title: Building arif4you
summary: Useful explanations and honest demonstrations of everyday technology.
body:
arif4you is my creator project about technology, productivity, and practical AI. The focus is on useful explanations and honest demonstrations.

The idea

Show a real problem, explain what changes, and give viewers something they can try themselves. Practical prompting is one starting point, including examples built around the MOLDS checklist.

The project is taking shape. This portfolio will grow alongside the content.
label: CREATOR PROJECT · IN DEVELOPMENT
